This Petition Coming On For Orders This Day, The
Court Made The Following:
 Order

1. The second respondent lodged the impugned FIR alleging that the petitioners herein subjected her to cruelty both mentally and physically, assaulted and demanded to bring money from her parental home.
The police registered FIR for the offences punishable under NC: 2023:KHC:40179 Sections 498-A, 323, 504 read with Section 34 of IPC and Sections 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961.
2. Petitioners are present through video conferencing and second respondent - Informant is present Sri. Abhishek Rana vs State Of Karnataka

2 before this Court and she is represented by her counsel.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioner has filed a memo placing the copy of the Memorandum of Settlement under Section 89 of CPC read with Rules 24 and 25 of the Karnataka Civil Procedure (Mediation) Rules, 2005.

Perusal of the Memorandum of Settlement indicated that the petitioner No.1 and the second respondent - Informant had filed a petition under Section 13-B of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955, for dissolving their marriage mutually and the matter was referred to the Bengaluru Mediation Centre.

Before the Mediation Centre, the parties amicably resolved dispute among themselves, and in terms of the settlement, their marriage has been dissolved mutually NC:
2023:KHC:40179 and a sum of Rs.14,00,000/- is paid towards permanent alimony in favour of the second respondent.
The second respondent has agreed to withdraw all the allegations against the petitioners herein.

4. Though the offences are cognizable and non- compoundable, however, having regard to the fact that the parties have amicably resolved their dispute, it would be a futile exercise, if the petitioners are subjected to investigation since the probability of the police filing the charge sheet against the petitioners is unlikely in view of the settlement.
Therefore, the continuation of the investigation will be an abuse of process of law.

Accordingly, I pass the following:-
ORDER i. The criminal petition is allowed.
ii. The impugned FIR in Crime No.209/2022 registered by the Women Police Station, NC: 2023:KHC:40179 Pulakeshinagar, Bengaluru, stands quashed.
